name: InferAll
description: Gateway whose open NVIDIA NIM models stay free every day after a short trial.
overview: InferAll fronts OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA NIM, Replicate and Runway behind one key. New accounts get 25 NIM-model calls up front, and after that the open NIM roster — Nemotron 3 Ultra, gpt-oss-20b and the rest — remains free at 25 calls a day, resetting at 00:00 UTC, with no card. A $5 starter pack raises the daily ceiling to 50 chat calls and becomes spendable balance. Non-retention is product intent rather than a contractual promise.
free_access: Open models at $0 in and $0 out
$5 starter pack lifts the cap to 50 calls/day
notes: The free allowance covers NVIDIA-hosted open models only; premium providers are metered.
